thread:
Ana Li: Hey team — planning a short bench-readout to review the Jan perf run + followups. Target ~30m. Proposed agenda: 1) perf highlights (latency, cost), 2) quick dashboard walkthrough, 3) quant/ batching experiments status, 4) rollout guardrails/canary plan, 5) next actions. Link to dashboard: https://redwood-internal/dash/latency-cost?view=bench-jan :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Ana Li: Can everyone do Wednesday 10:30-11:00 or Thursday 15:00-15:30 PT? Prefer Wed if ops can join. @Samir @Jess @Mike

Samir Rao: Wed 10:30 works for me. I can bring the p95 breakdown and the compare-to-last-deploy diffs.

Jess Taylor: Thu 15:00 is a hard no for me (customer calls). Wed is fine. Quick ask: add a 5-min slot for the new cache TTL experiment results — I have some numbers that change batching behavior.

Mike Chen: Wed 10:30 also ok. Will bring the cost-per-token calc + estimated savings from quant profiles. Also can share a short snippet of the new batching config: ```yaml
batcher:
  max_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 64
  max_latency_ms: 15
```

Ana Li: Great — locking Wed 10:30 PT then. I'll send calendar invite. Quick prep notes for presenters: Samir — p95 and tail lat charts (include model variant tags). Mike — cost delta table and which workloads saw biggest wins. Jess — TTL/ cache experiment summary + perf impact.

Samir Rao: One more: can we surface per-route cold-start counts? There's a spike in the readout that I want to explain. I can annotate the graph but would be good if ops can confirm host churn timestamps.

deploy-bot: deploy/infra noticed 2026-01-12T09:48Z rolling restart on infer-prod-4 cluster (reason: kernel patch). Affected hosts: 4/32.

Mike Chen: Thanks deploy-bot — that aligns with the spike. I'll add a note to the slides: explain correlation with small host churn + increased p95 for short sequences.

Jess Taylor: Also: can we add an agenda item to decide whether to enable the new quant config in dedicated for the canary? Quick thumbs up during the meeting should be fine.

Ana Li: Yep — we'll include canary decision. Action items pre-meeting: everyone drop 1–2 slides in the shared deck by Tue EOD: https://drive.redwood/teams/infer/bench-readout-deck. I'll post a short pre-read (1 pager) tomorrow with key numbers.

Samir Rao: Added my slides. Noted cold-start annotation.

Mike Chen: Slides uploaded. Included a small table: baseline vs q4-int8 vs q8-llm.

Jess Taylor: Uploaded TTL experiment notes.

Ana Li: Thanks all. See you Wed 10:30 PT — I'll ping 15m before with the join link. :thumbsup:
